images.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic educational demo photograph for a Chinese university art recreation project. Inspired by Gustave Courbet's painting The Desperate Man, depict a fictional East Asian male university student, age 22, short dark slightly wavy hair, wearing a loose off-white shirt with wide sleeves, standing in an ordinary dorm room in front of a dark olive brown cloth. Waist-up horizontal photograph, aspect ratio about 1.2:1. His torso faces camera, his intense face looks directly at camera, BOTH hands grip the sides of his head in his hair; BOTH elbows extend out sideways clearly and are raised to near head height, broad angular silhouette, shoulders and elbows and wrists visible without clipping. Similar composition to Courbet: face close to center slightly right, wide sleeves lower corners, large central upper body, wrists at temples. Natural warm side light, ordinary modern clothes and believable room texture, no historical costume, no brush strokes. No text, watermark, border or collage; one single photograph. This is a synthetic demonstration, not a real participant. Keep anatomy plausible and all relevant upper-body joints easy for pose estimation to see.

images.prompt: Create one photorealistic university art reenactment demo photo inspired by Joseph Ducreux's Self-Portrait, Yawning (by 1783). Clear asymmetric stretching gesture with both elbows and wrists visible and not clipped. Warm dark brown plain cloth backdrop in an ordinary room, natural window side lighting. Figure fills most of frame, portrait aspect ratio 4:5. Plausible real anatomy and everyday clothing, not a painting. Single photo, no text, watermark, collage or border.
